task.details:
Proposed goal: the storefront's whole look is a preset (medusa today, geist as the target) switched by <html data-theme>/<data-mode>, default medusa/light looks exactly as before, and Ivan can open a hidden settings panel on :8000 by holding the logo 2 s and entering the password. Proposed acceptance: (1) medusa.theme.json + geist.theme.json valid against theme-preset.schema.json, same key set in both modes, 'N keys, 0 missing' copied; (2) token-map.json bridge covers 88/88 preset variables with mapped/diverged/open counts copied; (3) four-page screenshots home/listing/PDP/cart: medusa/light pixel delta <= 0.1 % per page vs the pre-change baseline, numbers copied; geist light+dark with zero open fallbacks; (4) mock-up artifacts/docs/2026-09-06-theme-panel-mockup.md written BEFORE code, shows hold → dialog → button → popover → flips → reload; (5) Playwright in Docker: hold 1.5 s navigates, 2 s opens dialog, wrong password error + no cookie, right password cookie + button, preset flip changes --background, reload has data-theme before first paint, visitor HTML has no panel; reverse runs red; (6) next build green; (7) HUMAN EYES on :8000 after merge into dev: looks as before, hold logo 2 s → password → small button bottom-left → popover flips medusa/geist and light/dark live, back to medusa/light = old look, reload does not flash. Sequence: right after T0a/T0b, before T0c–T0g (00-program §11.2). WIP <= 2: approve as a third task or fold into t-ds-0-foundation (Ivan's call).
